cases.reason: A valid Corporate Number with only its check digit changed. Any validator that checks length alone accepts this.
cases.fix: The check digit is the FIRST digit, not the last: 9 − (Σ Pn×Qn) mod 9 over the remaining twelve, where Pn counts from the right and Qn alternates 1, 2.
cases.source: 国税庁 法人番号公表サイト — 法人番号の指定について (check-digit specification)

cases.reason: A transcription error in the last digit, which the check digit exists to catch.

cases.reason: The check digit is always 1–9, because 9 − (sum mod 9) cannot be 0. A Corporate Number beginning with 0 has been shifted or re-padded by numeric storage.
cases.fix: Store as a string. A leading zero is proof the value was damaged.
cases.source: 国税庁 法人番号公表サイト — 法人番号の指定について (check-digit specification)
